title: feat(crud-demo): tweak JWT TTL
body: Reduce default JWT TTL from 1h to 15m for stricter session control.
author: HuyTK
diff:
diff --git a/crud-demo/backend/app/auth.py b/crud-demo/backend/app/auth.py
--- a/crud-demo/backend/app/auth.py
+++ b/crud-demo/backend/app/auth.py
@@
-    JWT_TTL_SECONDS = int(os.getenv("APP_JWT_TTL_SECONDS", "3600"))
+    JWT_TTL_SECONDS = int(os.getenv("APP_JWT_TTL_SECONDS", "900"))
